title: Unit front-matter
description: Contract for front-matter of every unit file (index/activities/formative/summative/teacher-notes, and Spec 008's index/topic-NN/unit-assessment/unit-teacher-notes). Required fields gate the build (FR-009, SC-007); optional fields are shape-checked only when present. Answer-key fields are forbidden (FR-012). Spec 006 adds the optional `key_terms` field (FR-016c, research.md R4). Spec 008 adds the optional `topic_no` / `topic_label` fields — shape-checked here, but *required in practice on every `topic-*.mdx`* and enforced by scripts/validate-content.mjs (JSON Schema cannot see the filename to know a file is a topic file).

course_code.description: Must match parent course folder (uppercased). Placeholder codes like EFPC-4-- permitted while pending.

topic_no.description: Spec 008 per-topic layout: the topic's ordinal, equal to the `topic-NN.mdx` filename number. Required in practice on every topic file; absence (or a mismatch with the filename) is a validate-content.mjs failure, not a schema failure.

topic_label.description: Spec 008 per-topic layout: the human display label for the topic, e.g. "1.1". Required in practice on every topic file; used by scripts/check-figures.mjs to match a manifest row's `Topic` cell.

clo_refs.description: SLO-format outcome references 'SLO:<course-code>-<unit-no>-<n>' (e.g. SLO:EFMP-301-1-2). Field key stays 'clo_refs' per Constitution II.2; values are SLO refs.

coming_soon.description: true for scaffolded/un-authored units -> rendered 'coming soon' (SC-005).

resources.description: Reading materials / recommended books - cited only, never reproduced (Constitution III.5).

assessment_weighting.description: Default {summative:60, formative:40} (GECEs, Constitution III.7). Must sum to 100 - enforced by a custom validator check.

assessment_weighting_note.description: Justification for any per-unit deviation from the default 60/40 split (FR-010). Required in practice whenever assessment_weighting is not {60,40}; shape-checked when present.

key_terms.description: Spec 006 FR-016c/research.md R4: declared on a unit's Urdu index.mdx only. Each `en` is looked up in specs/content/terminology.csv; `ur` must equal the bank's term_ur for that term, checked by scripts/check-pipeline-gate.mjs. An `en` absent from the bank is flagged, not silently accepted.

description.description: One-sentence page description for search results and social cards (Spec 013 FR-014).
